name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: Image with initials fallback in a stable color. Five sizes, circle or square, presence dot (online, away, busy, offline), a stacked group with hover names, and UserInfo for avatar plus name and subtitle.
example:
import { Avatar, AvatarGroup, UserInfo } from '@/components/ui/avatar'; const team = ['Aarav Mehta', 'Diya Rao', 'Kabir Shah', 'Meera Iyer', 'Rohan Das', 'Isha Nair', 'Vikram Joshi']; export default function AvatarDemo() { return (
); }
htmlExample:
<bef-avatar name="Aarav Mehta" size="md" status="online"></bef-avatar>
<bef-avatar name="Diya Rao" size="lg" shape="square" status="away"></bef-avatar>
<bef-avatar-group :names='["Aarav Mehta","Diya Rao","Rohan Das","Isha Nair","Kabir Shah","Meera Iyer"]' :max="4"></bef-avatar-group>
<bef-user-info name="Isha Nair" subtitle="People Ops" status="busy" size="md"></bef-user-info>
